overview.en: This Lesser Antillean gecko occurs on Guadeloupe and nearby islands, Dominica and Montserrat. Its range differs from that of the Greater Antillean congener Sphaerodactylus elegans.
overview.fr: Ce gecko des Petites Antilles est présent en Guadeloupe et sur des îles voisines, à la Dominique et à Montserrat. Son aire diffère de celle de Sphaerodactylus elegans, son congénère des Grandes Antilles.

identification.en: The Reptile Database lists several geographically restricted named forms and notes that phyzacinus is now treated as a valid species.
identification.fr: The Reptile Database répertorie plusieurs formes nommées à répartition restreinte et indique que phyzacinus est désormais traité comme une espèce valide.

habitat.en: On Dominica, the named form fuga has been reported in relatively moist microhabitats along the western coast.
habitat.fr: À la Dominique, la forme nommée fuga a été signalée dans des microhabitats relativement humides de la côte occidentale.

diet.en: The field study reviewed here does not report prey or establish a species-specific diet.
diet.fr: L’étude de terrain consultée ne décrit pas de proies et n’établit pas de régime propre à l’espèce.

behavior.en: The cited Dominica study measures population density and water loss, rather than providing a broader behavioral account.
behavior.fr: L’étude citée sur la Dominique mesure la densité de population et les pertes en eau, sans fournir de description plus générale du comportement.

reproduction.en: The Reptile Database records it as oviparous.
reproduction.fr: The Reptile Database indique que cette espèce est ovipare.

ecology.en: Its named island forms have localized ranges; see Sphaerodactylus elegans for a congener native to Cuba and Hispaniola and introduced in Florida.
ecology.fr: Ses formes insulaires nommées ont des aires localisées; voir Sphaerodactylus elegans, un congénère originaire de Cuba et d’Hispaniola, introduit en Floride.

conservation.en: The 2022 Guadeloupe Red List assigns this gecko Least Concern regionally and globally; that assessment predates the current separation of S. phyzacinus as a valid species.
conservation.fr: La Liste rouge de Guadeloupe de 2022 classe ce gecko en Préoccupation mineure à l’échelle régionale et mondiale; cette évaluation précède la séparation actuelle de S. phyzacinus comme espèce valide.

facts: The database gives a Lesser Antillean distribution, records named island forms, notes phyzacinus is treated as a valid species, and lists oviparity.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Population densities and water-loss rates of Sphaerodactylus fantasticus fuga on Dominica
title.fr: Densités de population et pertes en eau de Sphaerodactylus fantasticus fuga à la Dominique

facts: The study describes S. f. fuga as a dwarf gecko of relatively mesic microhabitats on the western coast of Dominica and reports density and water-loss measurements.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

facts: The congeneric S. elegans is native to Cuba and Hispaniola and has introduced populations in Florida.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: The Red List of threatened species in France: Guadeloupe fauna
title.fr: La Liste rouge des espèces menacées en France : faune de Guadeloupe

facts: The 2022 Guadeloupe Red List table lists Sphaerodactylus fantasticus as Least Concern in Guadeloupe and globally; its taxonomy predates the current separation of S. phyzacinus.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Diet and detailed behavior were not established by the sources used for this short account.
Current taxonomic treatment of the named island forms differs from older literature; the draft follows the cited Reptile Database.
The 2022 Red List status follows its then-current taxonomic treatment; the current separation of S. phyzacinus may warrant a reassessment of scope.
review_note: Draft only. An English taxonomic database, a Dominica field study and a French Guadeloupe Red List were cross-checked; the reciprocal S. elegans mention is geographic, not a claim of close sister relationship.
